info.title: Track 3 Accessible Learning & Help Assistant API
info.description:
Clean Architecture REST API for the multilingual learning and help assistant.

### Architecture and Security Principles
- **Transport Independence:** Domain models and business logic remain independent of Fastify HTTP details.
- **Identity & Least Privilege:** Role-based access control enforces learner-owned data privacy (`learner`), staff queue claim workflows (`support`), and coordinator triage (`coordinator`).
- **Consistent Error Envelopes:** Error responses adhere to standardized JSON error envelopes (`{ error: string, message?: string, reason?: string }`).
- **Secrets Hygiene:** Examples contain strictly synthetic tokens, test hashes, and anonymized placeholders. Real credentials, live tokens, and PII are strictly excluded.

### Channel Limitations and Infrastructure
- **Offline / Local Availability:** Course content search and FAQ answer retrieval operate fully offline and in local development without external API keys or cloud dependencies.
- **AI Tutoring:** Online AI-grounded tutoring relies on Google Gemini API when configured and consented; fallback to approved FAQ content occurs automatically when consent is declined or offline.
- **Screen Sharing:** Peer-to-peer WebRTC signalling is ephemeral and in-memory; public Google STUN (`stun:stun.l.google.com:19302`) and optional Coturn TURN relay handle NAT traversal without server-side media recording.
- **SMS & Delivery Outbox:** SMS job alert delivery uses an internal transactional outbox (`delivery_intents` table) and background worker via AfroMessage, not an external HTTP API.
- **Telegram Channel:** Telegram identity linking uses single-use expiring codes and verified webhooks (`x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token`).

get.description: Returns 200 OK as long as the HTTP process is running, regardless of database or third-party status.
Checks PostgreSQL connectivity and migration state. Returns 200 if ready to serve database-backed requests, or 503 if unavailable.

503.description: API is not ready to serve database traffic

get.description: Returns the identity, role, and permissions of the principal authenticated via Bearer token.

403.description: Origin not allowed to initiate demo sessions

delete.description: Immediately revokes the active demo session token presented in the Authorization header.

400.description: Presented token is not a revocable session token (e.g. provisioned operator key)

get.description: Demonstrates staff role authorization guard. Learners receive 403 Forbidden.
